reason: The open-access Springer article evaluates active-learning classifier and feature-extractor combinations over more than 29,000 systematic-review screening simulations. It finds no universally best model and studies screening efficiency; it does not optimize LLM inference, compression, or serving. The MiniLMv2 linkage is contextual to screening models rather than a compression contribution.
title: Large-scale simulation study of active learning models for systematic reviews
